description: An Apache Beam streaming pipeline that reads events from Cloud Pub/Sub, and writes into BigQuery
name: Analytics Event Ingestion

parameters.helpText: Provide the name of subscription to ingest.
parameters.label: Input Subscription
parameters.name: inputSubscription

parameters.helpText: Provide the output directory to backup events from Cloud Pub/Sub.
parameters.label: Output Directory
parameters.name: outputDirectory

parameters.helpText: Provide the prefix of file names of backup events (default is output).
parameters.label: Output File Name Prefix
parameters.name: outputFileNamePrefix

parameters.helpText: Provide how long to allow late-arriving events for sessions in minutes (default is 5).
parameters.label: Session Window Allowed Lateness
parameters.name: sessionWindowAllowedLateness

parameters.helpText: Provide the interval for early window pane firings before session close (default is 1).
parameters.label: Session Window Early Firings Interval
parameters.name: sessionWindowEarlyFiringsInterval

parameters.helpText: Provide the gap duration to close session in minutes (default is 30).
parameters.label: Session Window Gap Duration
parameters.name: sessionWindowGapDuration

parameters.helpText: Provide the interval to write events to backup in minutes (default is 5).
parameters.label: Write Interval
parameters.name: writeInterval
